defect: the edge detector timing clock is declared on d_i instead of clk_i
rationale: The synchronizer and edge-history register are clocked by clk_i. d_i is the signal being sampled, so constraining it as a clock leaves the actual detector clock unconstrained.

mutation.description: Placed create_clock on the sampled d_i input rather than the clk_i clock port.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the synchronized input and previous-sample edge detector; removed the reusable synchronizer module boundary and technology-cell macros.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Clock is created on data input d_i, leaving clk_i unclocked.
